26	// Detecta sequências repetitivas: A→B→A→B com threshold
27	function detectLoops(transitions: Array<{ from: string; to: string }>): Array<string[]> {
28	    if (transitions.length < LOOP_THRESHOLD * 2) return []
29	
30	    const loops: Array<string[]> = []
31	    const seen = new Map<string, number>()
32	
33	    // Sliding window de pares
34	    for (let i = 0; i < transitions.length - 1; i++) {
35	        const pair = `${transitions[i].from}→${transitions[i].to}`
36	        const reversePair = `${transitions[i].to}→${transitions[i].from}`
37	
38	        const count = seen.get(pair) || 0
39	        seen.set(pair, count + 1)
40	
41	        // Verifica se par e seu reverso aparecem alternadamente
42	        if ((seen.get(pair) ?? 0) >= LOOP_THRESHOLD && (seen.get(reversePair) ?? 0) >= LOOP_THRESHOLD) {
43	            loops.push([transitions[i].from, transitions[i].to])
44	        }
45	    }
46	
47	    return [...new Map(loops.map(l => [l.join('→'), l])).values()]
48	}

61	        .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
62	        .limit(200)

64	    if (!navData?.length) return { loops: 0, flowsUpdated: false }
65	
66	    const transitions = navData
67	        .filter(e => e.properties?.next_page)
68	        .map(e => ({ from: e.page, to: e.properties.next_page as string }))
69	
70	    if (!transitions.length) return { loops: 0, flowsUpdated: false }
71	
72	    // Detecta loops
73	    const loopSequences = detectLoops(transitions)
74	
75	    if (loopSequences.length > 0) {
76	        for (const loop of loopSequences) {
77	            await supabase.from('user_loops').upsert({
78	                user_id: userId,
79	                loop_pages: loop,
80	                occurrences: LOOP_THRESHOLD,
81	                last_seen_at: new Date().toISOString(),
82	            }, { onConflict: 'user_id,loop_pages', ignoreDuplicates: false })
83	
84	            // Agenda notificação de loop — SÓ se a proatividade estiver ligada.
85	            // O aprendizado (user_loops, loop_count) continua independente do switch.
86	            if (proactiveOn) {

88	                    user_id: userId,
89	                    type: 'loop_friction',
90	                    title: '💡 Atalho detectado',
91	                    body: `Notei que você frequentemente vai de ${loop[0]} para ${loop[1]} e volta. Posso criar um atalho para isso?`,
92	                    context: { loop_pages: loop },
93	                    priority: 5,
94	                    expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 3_600_000).toISOString(),
95	                })
96	            }
97	
98	            // Atualiza contador no perfil
99	            await supabase.from('mia_user_patterns').upsert({
100	                user_id: userId,
101	                loop_count: loopSequences.length,
102	                last_loop_detected_at: new Date().toISOString(),
103	            }, { onConflict: 'user_id', ignoreDuplicates: false })
104	        }
105	    }
106	
107	    // Calcula top_flows (sequências de 3 páginas mais comuns)
108	    const trigramMap = new Map<string, number>()
109	    for (let i = 0; i < transitions.length - 1; i++) {
110	        if (i + 1 < transitions.length && transitions[i].to === transitions[i + 1].from) {
111	            const trigram = `${transitions[i].from}→${transitions[i].to}→${transitions[i + 1].to}`
112	            trigramMap.set(trigram, (trigramMap.get(trigram) ?? 0) + 1)
113	        }
114	    }
115	
116	    const topFlows = [...trigramMap.entries()]
117	        .sort(([, a], [, b]) => b - a)
118	        .slice(0, 5)
119	        .map(([flow, count]) => ({ flow: flow.split('→'), count }))
120	
121	    if (topFlows.length > 0) {
122	        await supabase.from('mia_user_patterns').upsert({
123	            user_id: userId,
124	            top_flows: topFlows,
125	            behavioral_updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
126	        }, { onConflict: 'user_id', ignoreDuplicates: false })
127	    }
128	
129	    return { loops: loopSequences.length, flowsUpdated: topFlows.length > 0 }
130	}

78	        ? `scope.eq.global,scope.eq.role:${roleNorm}`
79	        : 'scope.eq.global'
80	
81	    try {
82	        const [wfResult, memResult, behavioralResult, distilledResult] = await Promise.all([
83	            // RPC com relevance ranking (tsvector portuguese + boost use_count)
84	            supabase.rpc('mia_workflows_by_relevance', {
85	                p_user_id: userId,
86	                p_query: query,
87	                p_limit: MAX_WORKFLOWS,
88	            }),
89	            supabase.rpc('mia_memories_by_relevance', {
90	                p_user_id: userId,
91	                p_query: query,
92	                p_limit: MAX_MEMORIES,
93	            }),
94	            // Perfil comportamental completo (L3)
95	            supabase.rpc('get_behavioral_profile', { p_user_id: userId }),
96	            // Distilled patterns globais + por role do user (Padrão 1)
97	            supabase.from('mia_distilled_patterns')
98	                .select('title, content, category, confidence')
99	                .eq('active', true)
100	                .or(scopeFilter)
101	                .order('confidence', { ascending: false })
102	                .limit(10),
103	        ])
104	
105	        const workflows = (wfResult.data ?? []).map((w: any) => ({
106	            name: String(w.name ?? ''),
107	            triggers: Array.isArray(w.trigger_phrases) ? w.trigger_phrases : [],
108	            steps_count: Array.isArray(w.steps) ? w.steps.length : 0,
109	            page_path: w.page_path ?? null,
110	            use_count: Number(w.use_count ?? 0),
111	            // relevance retornado pela RPC; útil pra debug, não enviado pro prompt
112	        }))
113	
114	        const memories = (memResult.data ?? []).map((m: any) => ({
115	            type: String(m.type ?? 'fact'),
116	            fact: String(m.fact ?? ''),
117	            description: m.description ?? null,
118	            confidence: typeof m.confidence === 'number' ? m.confidence : null,
119	            source: m.extracted_by ?? null,
120	        }))
121	
122	        const behavioral = behavioralResult.data ? (behavioralResult.data as BehavioralProfile) : null
123	        const distilledPatterns = ((distilledResult.data ?? []) as Array<{ title: string; content: string; category: string }>)
124	
125	        return { workflows, memories, behavioral, distilledPatterns }
126	    } catch (err) {
127	        console.warn('[MIA UserContext] load failed:', err)
128	        return empty
129	    }
130	}

135	export function formatUserContextForPrompt(bundle: UserContextBundle): string {
136	    const hasData = bundle.workflows.length > 0 || bundle.memories.length > 0 ||
137	        bundle.behavioral !== null || bundle.distilledPatterns.length > 0
138	    if (!hasData) return ''
139	
140	    const lines: string[] = ['## L4 — Contexto personalizado deste usuário']
141	
142	    // Distilled patterns (Padrão 1 — aprendizado acumulado do uso real)
143	    if (bundle.distilledPatterns.length > 0) {
144	        lines.push('', '### Padrões aprendidos do uso real da Momma')
145	        for (const p of bundle.distilledPatterns) {
146	            lines.push(`**[${p.category}] ${p.title}**`)
147	            lines.push(p.content)
148	        }
149	    }
150	
151	    // Perfil comportamental (L3 — como este usuário usa o sistema)
152	    if (bundle.behavioral) {
153	        const b = bundle.behavioral
154	        lines.push('', '### Comportamento observado (analytics)')
155	
156	        if (b.top_pages?.length > 0) {
157	            const pages = b.top_pages.slice(0, 5).map(p => `${p.page}(${p.count}×)`).join(', ')
158	            lines.push(`- Páginas mais acessadas: ${pages}`)
159	        }
160	
161	        if (b.top_nav_transitions?.length > 0) {
162	            const flows = b.top_nav_transitions.slice(0, 3).map(t => `${t.from}→${t.to}`).join('; ')
163	            lines.push(`- Fluxos mais comuns: ${flows}`)
164	        }
165	
166	        const peakHour = b.peak_hours
167	            ? Object.entries(b.peak_hours).sort(([, a], [, b]) => Number(b) - Number(a))[0]
168	            : null
169	        if (peakHour) {
170	            lines.push(`- Horário de pico: ${peakHour[0]}h`)
171	        }
172	
173	        if (b.mia_suggestion_act_rate > 0) {
174	            lines.push(`- Taxa de ação em sugestões MIA: ${Math.round(b.mia_suggestion_act_rate * 100)}%`)
175	        }
176	
177	        if (b.active_loop) {
178	            const loopPages = b.active_loop.pages.join('→')
179	            lines.push(`- ⚠️ Loop de fricção detectado: ${loopPages} (${b.active_loop.occurrences}×) — considere oferecer atalho`)
180	        }
181	
182	        if (b.counterfactual_avg_dwell_ms && b.avg_dwell_ms) {
183	            lines.push(`- Baseline sem MIA: ${Math.round(b.counterfactual_avg_dwell_ms / 1000)}s médios por página`)
184	        }
185	    }
186	
187	    if (bundle.workflows.length > 0) {
188	        lines.push('', '### Workflows salvos (atalhos pessoais)')
189	        for (const w of bundle.workflows) {
190	            const triggerStr = w.triggers.length > 0 ? ` — gatilhos: ${w.triggers.join(', ')}` : ''
191	            const pageStr = w.page_path ? ` (página: ${w.page_path})` : ''
192	            lines.push(`- **${w.name}** (${w.steps_count} passos, usado ${w.use_count}×)${triggerStr}${pageStr}`)
193	        }
194	        lines.push('', 'Se intent do user casa com gatilho de algum workflow acima, OFEREÇA executar esse workflow em vez de planejar do zero.')
195	    }
196	
197	    if (bundle.memories.length > 0) {
198	        lines.push('', '### Memórias e preferências')
199	        for (const m of bundle.memories) {
200	            const confStr = m.confidence !== null ? ` (conf=${Math.round(m.confidence * 100)}%)` : ''
201	            lines.push(`- [${m.type}] ${m.fact}${confStr}`)
202	        }
203	        lines.push('', 'Use essas preferências como defaults. Se intent não as contradiz, aplique sem perguntar.')
204	    }
205	
206	    return lines.join('\n')
207	}

233	-- 8. Trigger: atualiza perfil comportamental em tempo real
234	--    após cada insert em gidape_events
235	-- ============================================================
236	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_update_behavioral_profile()
237	RETURNS TRIGGER LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
238	DECLARE
239	    v_hour int4;
240	    v_peak jsonb;
241	    v_feat jsonb;
242	    v_feat_id text;
243	    v_feat_count int4;
244	    v_pages jsonb;
245	    v_page_entry jsonb;
246	    v_page_found bool := false;
247	    v_dwell_ms int8;
248	    v_page text;
249	    v_from text;
250	    v_to text;
251	BEGIN
252	    v_hour := EXTRACT(HOUR FROM NEW.created_at)::int4;
253	    v_page := NEW.page;
254	
255	    -- Garante linha em mia_user_patterns
256	    INSERT INTO mia_user_patterns(user_id)
257	        VALUES(NEW.user_id)
258	        ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING;
259	
260	    -- Atualiza peak_hours
261	    SELECT COALESCE(peak_hours, '{}') INTO v_peak FROM mia_user_patterns WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id;
262	    v_peak := jsonb_set(v_peak, ARRAY[v_hour::text], to_jsonb(COALESCE((v_peak ->> v_hour::text)::int4, 0) + 1));
263	
264	    -- Contabiliza feature_use
265	    IF NEW.event_type = 'feature_use' THEN
266	        v_feat_id := NEW.properties->>'feature_id';
267	        IF v_feat_id IS NOT NULL THEN
268	            SELECT COALESCE(feature_usage_map, '{}') INTO v_feat FROM mia_user_patterns WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id;
269	            v_feat_count := COALESCE((v_feat ->> v_feat_id)::int4, 0) + 1;
270	            v_feat := jsonb_set(v_feat, ARRAY[v_feat_id], to_jsonb(v_feat_count));
271	            UPDATE mia_user_patterns
272	                SET feature_usage_map = v_feat,
273	                    peak_hours = v_peak,
274	                    behavioral_updated_at = now()
275	                WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id;
276	            RETURN NEW;
277	        END IF;
278	    END IF;
279	
280	    -- page_exit: atualiza avg_dwell_ms por página e nav_graph
281	    IF NEW.event_type = 'page_exit' THEN
282	        v_dwell_ms := (NEW.properties->>'dwell_ms')::int8;
283	        v_from := v_page;
284	        v_to := NEW.properties->>'next_page';
285	
286	        -- Atualiza avg_dwell_ms no perfil
287	        IF v_dwell_ms IS NOT NULL AND v_dwell_ms > 0 THEN
288	            DECLARE
289	                v_dwell_map jsonb;
290	                v_old_avg int8;
291	                v_old_count int4;
292	                v_new_avg int8;
293	            BEGIN
294	                SELECT COALESCE(avg_dwell_ms, '{}') INTO v_dwell_map FROM mia_user_patterns WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id;
295	                v_old_avg := COALESCE((v_dwell_map -> v_page ->> 'avg')::int8, 0);
296	                v_old_count := COALESCE((v_dwell_map -> v_page ->> 'count')::int4, 0);
297	                v_new_avg := ((v_old_avg * v_old_count) + v_dwell_ms) / (v_old_count + 1);
298	                v_dwell_map := jsonb_set(
299	                    v_dwell_map,
300	                    ARRAY[v_page],
301	                    jsonb_build_object('avg', v_new_avg, 'count', v_old_count + 1)
302	                );
303	                UPDATE mia_user_patterns
304	                    SET avg_dwell_ms = v_dwell_map, peak_hours = v_peak, behavioral_updated_at = now()
305	                    WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id;
306	            END;
307	        END IF;
308	
309	        -- Atualiza nav_graph (from → to)
310	        IF v_from IS NOT NULL AND v_to IS NOT NULL AND v_from != v_to THEN
311	            INSERT INTO user_nav_graph(user_id, from_page, to_page, weight, last_seen_at)
312	                VALUES(NEW.user_id, v_from, v_to, 1, now())
313	                ON CONFLICT (user_id, from_page, to_page)
314	                DO UPDATE SET weight = user_nav_graph.weight + 1, last_seen_at = now();
315	        END IF;
316	
317	        RETURN NEW;
318	    END IF;
319	
320	    -- mia_suggestion_acted: atualiza taxa de aceitação
321	    IF NEW.event_type = 'mia_suggestion_acted' THEN
322	        UPDATE mia_user_patterns
323	            SET mia_suggestion_act_rate = (
324	                -- média móvel exponencial simples (α=0.2)
325	                COALESCE(mia_suggestion_act_rate, 0) * 0.8 +
326	                CASE WHEN (NEW.properties->>'acted')::bool THEN 0.2 ELSE 0 END
327	            ),
328	            peak_hours = v_peak,
329	            behavioral_updated_at = now()
330	            WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id;
331	        RETURN NEW;
332	    END IF;
333	
334	    -- Atualiza top_pages
335	    IF NEW.event_type = 'page_enter' THEN
336	        SELECT COALESCE(top_pages, '[]') INTO v_pages FROM mia_user_patterns WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id;
337	
338	        -- Procura página existente no array e incrementa count
339	        SELECT
340	            (SELECT jsonb_agg(
341	                CASE WHEN elem->>'page' = v_page
342	                    THEN jsonb_set(elem, '{count}', to_jsonb((elem->>'count')::int4 + 1))
343	                    ELSE elem END
344	            ) FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_pages) elem),
345	            EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_pages) elem WHERE elem->>'page' = v_page)
346	        INTO v_pages, v_page_found;
347	
348	        IF NOT v_page_found THEN
349	            v_pages := v_pages || jsonb_build_object('page', v_page, 'count', 1);
350	        END IF;
351

### Kill-switch correctness — VERDICT: correct in all four functions
- **morning-digest** (`index.ts:170`): early-returns before `fetchActiveUsers`/deliver when disabled. Fail-safe `false` on error/missing row. Correct.
- **anomaly-watcher** (`index.ts:145`): early-returns before detect+persist. Correct.

- **distillation**: no kill-switch gating, always learns. Correct per invariant.

### CONFIRMED findings

**1. [CRITICAL] distillation — `gidape_events.eq('session_id', session.id)` is dead code; `session_pages` is always `[]`**
File: `mia-distillation/index.ts:77-83`. `session.id` comes from `mia_sessions` (frontend session string). But `gidape_events.session_id` is a *different id space* (frontend behavior-session uuid), never equal to `mia_sessions.id`. The query returns 0 rows every run, so `session_pages` is always empty, and the prompt line `Páginas visitadas: ${s.session_pages.join(', ')}` (line 109) is always blank — misleading the LLM into thinking no pages were visited.
**Note — the prompt's premise was slightly off:** it claimed the `chat_messages.eq('session_id', session.id)` query is the empty one. That one is actually **fine** — `mia/index.ts:4112-4118` saves web messages with `session_id = session_id` AND `upsertSession({ id: session_id })`, so `chat_messages.session_id == mia_sessions.id`. The dead query is the `gidape_events` one, not `chat_messages`.
**Fix:** either drop `session_pages` entirely, or join correctly — fetch `gidape_events` by `user_id` + time-window of the session (`created_at` between session start/last_activity), since there's no shared session key.
Severity: **major** (dead/misleading prompt input, not a crash).

**2. [CRITICAL] `mia_get_user_role` returns scalar `text`, but all three callers parse it as an object/array**
Files: `mia-morning-digest/index.ts:30`, `mia-anomaly-watcher/index.ts:97`, `mia-distillation/index.ts:48`. The RPC (`20260506220000_mia_get_user_role.sql`) is `RETURNS text` — supabase-js returns `data` as a **string** (or `null`). The code: `typeof data === 'string' ? data : (data?.[0]?.role ?? data?.role ?? 'operador')`. The string branch works, so it's not broken at runtime — **but** the object/array fallbacks are dead, and more importantly the **NULL handling is wrong**: when the user has no `role_id`, the RPC returns `null`; the migration's own comment says callers must treat that as `'unknown'`, NOT `'operador'`. morning-digest and anomaly-watcher coerce `null → 'operador'` (`|| 'operador'`). For anomaly-watcher this is **security-relevant**: `'operador'` is filtered out of `gestao` (line 102-103), so a null-role user silently gets no alerts — acceptable fail-closed. But morning-digest fabricates role `operador` into the LLM prompt for users the system explicitly can't classify. distillation correctly defaults to `'unknown'`. 
**Fix:** standardize to `(typeof data === 'string' ? data : null) ?? 'unknown'` and drop the `.[0]?.role/.role` shapes that can never occur. Severity: **major** (correctness + inconsistency; `'operador'` is a non-existent role per the migration comment).

**3. [MINOR] anomaly-watcher recipient filter can double-count / mis-scope**
File: `mia-anomaly-watcher/index.ts:114-117`. `recipients` filter: `role.startsWith('master') || role.startsWith('admin') || a.loja_id === null || t.store_id === a.loja_id`. The `a.loja_id === null` clause means **every** target (including a `gerente` of loja 2) receives every null-loja anomaly — that's intended for `producao_ausente` (loja_id null). But estoque anomalies always carry a real `loja_id`, and `producao_ausente` is fábrica-wide, so a store gerente gets the "no production today" alert for the factory. Likely undesired noise. Also `role.startsWith('admin')` matches both `admin` and `administrador`/`administrator` — fine — but `getTargetUsers` already filtered to `gestao` roles, so the broad `startsWith` is redundant. Severity: **minor** (scoping noise, not a crash).

**4. [MINOR] pattern-analyzer `updateCounterfactualBaseline` — with-MIA branch is collected but never used**
